review: Static read-only isolation review of private frozen-backend launcher
checks: Launcher compiles with Python compile() without producing bytecode or launching a server.
Requires runtime path to resolve beneath _easy_claude_work and validates exact frozen SHA-256 pins for server.py plus PSD-import and render-file route modules before import.
Rejects the live port 59876 and validates a private profile path; verifies a local port is available before startup.
Sets SPB_NO_LIVE_LINK and SPB_ISOLATED_OUTPUT_DIR plus private project, MCP, user-import, APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA roots before importing config or application modules.
Sets sys.dont_write_bytecode before project imports, avoiding shared Python bytecode-cache writes during private startup.

Config singleton is redirected to private config before importing/registering frozen server routes; the config-route registration wrapper redirects the actual server module CONFIG_FILE global and verifies load/save closures share that module before route registration.
Project directory resolver is overridden to the private output tree; launcher records before/after owner-file digests and asserts they did not change.
V5 app runs without importing or executing __main__; SHOKKER_NO_CLEAN=1 and SPB_NO_BOOT_SWATCH_WARM=1 are set.
disclosures: The launcher reads root shokker_config.json and .server_port bytes only to compute pre/post SHA-256 integrity pins. It does not parse/load them as app configuration or write them. Thus the source comment 'No owner-config read' is imprecise if interpreted as zero filesystem reads.

The source initializes config.CFG.CONFIG_FILE to its normal root pathname before immediately redirecting the singleton; bounded source inspection shows config singleton construction creates only OUTPUT_DIR under the isolated environment and does not itself load CONFIG_FILE. Application server globals are redirected before config routes are registered.

Free-port check closes its probe socket before Flask binds, so a normal local port race remains possible. The requested port cannot equal live port 59876; no server was launched to test actual bind behavior.
limits: Static/source review only; launcher was not executed and no backend process was started.
No owner config was parsed or modified; no native app, provider, customer file, live endpoint or external service was used.
